title: Parasite Crown
text: A ring of feeding rivets tightens whenever a weapon wakes.
flavor: It applauds violence with a turn of every screw.
origin: A battlefield control circlet rooted into the skull after its operator died.
burdenText: The first Equipment used in battle each round exhausts after that battle.
adaptationText: Once per battle, when exactly one below the opposing total, add +1.
trigger: The first Equipment used in battle each round.

effect.text: Parasite Crown marked the first battle Equipment for exhaustion.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: The crown can bridge an exact one-point battle deficit.
